title: Patient Coordinator
company: Hair O Craft Hair and Skin Clinic
description:
Patient Management

* Handle patient inquiries via phone, email, WhatsApp, and in-person visits.
* Schedule and coordinate consultations, procedures, and follow-up appointments.
* Guide patients through treatment plans, procedure details, and pre/post-operative instructions.
* Maintain regular communication with patients before and after procedures.

Consultation Coordination

* Assist doctors and consultants during patient consultations.
* Collect and maintain patient records, photographs, and medical documentation.
* Explain treatment packages, pricing, and payment options to prospective patients.
* Follow up with leads and consultation patients to support treatment conversion.

Administrative Duties

* Maintain accurate patient records and clinic databases.
* Prepare consent forms and other required documentation.
* Coordinate appointment calendars for doctors and clinical staff.
* Ensure patient files are complete and updated.

Patient Experience

* Welcome patients and ensure a positive clinic experience.
* Address patient concerns and escalate issues when necessary.
* Monitor patient satisfaction and gather feedback.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information.

Sales & Follow-Up

* Follow up on consultation leads and treatment inquiries.
* Support achievement of clinic conversion and patient retention goals.
* Coordinate promotional campaigns and referral programs when required.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹21,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
Company Name: Thamarappally Brothers Veneers and Panels Private Limited

Our web Portal: **www.jacinteriorstore.com**

**Manufacturers of pre-hung doors & Interior related Products**

**Working Time: 8:30am to 5:00pm**

Location: **THIRUVALLA**

We are a leading manufacturer and retailer of pre-hung doors, wooden flooring, veneers, and interior products, with a growing network of showrooms across multiple districts.

We are looking for a dynamic and responsible professional to lead our Customer Care & Installation Services function, ensuring seamless post-sales experience and high customer satisfaction across all our branches.

**Key Responsibilities**:

- Handle customer queries and provide technical support

- Coordinate with building projects, consultants and contractors

- Coordinate supply, site installation and handover of pre-hung doors (doors with frame)

- Work closely with internal team (sales, ,production, planning and logistics)

- Ensure timely execution and resolution of customer issues.

- Build and maintain strong customer relationships

- Prepare reports and follow-up for project progress

Guide and supervise installation teams for quality execution

- Identify and resolve site-related issues affecting product performance

- Maintain service standards and improve customer experience systems

- Coordinate closely with showroom teams, factory, and installers

- Prepare regular service reports and performance reviews

**Candidate Profile**:

- 5+ years' experience in interiors, doors, furniture, or construction-related services

- Good communication and interpersonal skills

- Ability to coordinate multiple projects

- Customer focused and solution oriented mindset

- Knowledge of building materials, construction processes and door installation methods preferable.

- Proficiency in MS Office and reports.

- Willingness to travel across branch locations

**What we offer**:

- Opportunity to build and lead a critical function

- Growth in a professionally managed, expanding organization

- Competitive compensation with performance incentives

**Salary will not be a constraint for the right candidate**

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Diploma (Preferred)

Location:

* Tiruvalla, Kerala (Preferred)
